description: Which US zip codes match these rental-market criteria? Filters 30,000+ US zip codes by state, cap rate, vacancy, rent, population, home value, and renter share. Returns matching zips with key investor metrics and a doorbase.app link for each. Cap rates are a modeled band; min_cap_rate matches the band's high end.

max_median_home_value.description: Maximum median home value in USD.

max_median_rent.description: Maximum median monthly rent in USD.

min_cap_rate.description: Minimum estimated cap rate in percent; matches cap_rate_high (band top) >= value.

min_median_rent.description: Minimum median monthly rent in USD.

state.description: 2-letter US state code, e.g. GA. Omit for nationwide.

name: search_markets
title: Search US rental markets by zip
